title: fix(plugin-kanban): name the card lists and drag overlay from the pack
body:
Fixes #12838
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The kanban board's three interpolating accessible names wrapped a label in English words, so under zh the lane list read "待规划 cards". Each is now one pack sentence with the label interpolated, read through the board's own translation hook (`useKanbanT`, the `createSafeTranslation` instance in `KanbanImpl.tsx` that objectui#12716's drag announcements and objectui#12837's card description already read), in the `kanban` namespace:

| element | before | key | en (unchanged) | zh |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| a lane's card list | template "COLUMN cards" | `kanban.columnCards` | `{{column}} cards` | `{{column}} 的卡片` |
| a swimlane cell's card list | template "COLUMN - LANE cards" | `kanban.laneCards` | `{{column}} - {{lane}} cards` | `{{column}} - {{lane}} 的卡片` |
| the drag overlay | template "Dragging TITLE" | `kanban.dnd.dragging` | `Dragging {{card}}` | `正在拖动 {{card}}` |

The keys are added to all ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs with real translations, and to the hook's English defaults (so a board with no `I18nProvider` reads exactly as before). No other file and no other key changed.

## Tests

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/ariaLabelTemplates-12838.test.tsx`, on the real board and the real `DndContext` (no module mocks): the packs disagree for each key; under zh, the lane list, a swimlane cell and the drag overlay (painted by a real pointer pick-up past the 5px activation distance) are each named by the zh sentence with the value filled in; CONTROL, under en the three names read exactly `To do cards`, `To do - ann cards`, `Dragging Content backlog`, and with no provider the same English sentences.

Ablation (one-off, no permanent file), run through `ablation-replace.mjs` after the fix was committed: the lane list put back to the English template, anchor 1 to 0, blob `4220d7a5b598` to `d3fd821da2f4`; exactly the zh lane-list case went red (`Tests 1 failed | 7 passed`), the en control stayed green; restore proven by blob hash (after restore `4220d7a5b598` = HEAD blob) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

All readings at `253ed3d333`:
- vitest, new file: 8 passed (8). `packages/plugin-kanban/`: 76 files, 514 tests passed. `packages/i18n/`: 83 files, 1325 passed, 13 skipped.
- closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-kanban^...'`: 12/12 tasks. `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: exit 0 (the new test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s file list, counted with `--listFiles`).
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (3 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (no new key listed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, and the rest of the pre-tsc battery: exit 0. `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0. `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, `no-artifact` (it wants a whole-workspace build); recorded, not fixed.
- lint, narrowed to the 12 changed files: eslint with `--no-inline-config --format json`, 12 files, 0 errors, 1 warning (`no-explicit-any` at `KanbanImpl.tsx:234`, the same line as base `:227`, not touched here). The root `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of this card's scope by ruling:** the repo-wide enumeration pin over interpolating `aria-label` templates (triage: a new gate defaults to no). The pin here is beside the board only.
- **No other English template `aria-label` is in `KanbanImpl.tsx`.** The other `aria-label`s there are the bare value (`card.title`, `owner.name`, `column.title`) or the two LITERALS "Kanban board with swimlanes" / "Kanban board", which are a different class: they are frozen members of the literal census BACKLOG (`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145.test.ts`), whose removal edits that census and about six existing kanban pins. Left as they are.
- **Same class, another file (reported, not fixed):** `packages/plugin-kanban/src/CardTemplates.tsx:69` names its button with the template "Add card to COLUMN_ID" (an option value, not a label) and paints a visible "Add Card". `CardTemplates` is exported from the package entry but no in-repo source imports it.
- **Seen, not measured:** in swimlane mode the lane for cards with no value is the English constant `UNCATEGORIZED_LANE` ("Uncategorized"), shown as the lane heading and now interpolated into `kanban.laneCards`. The packs have `kanban.uncategorized`, which `KanbanBoardCore.tsx` reads for the column path but `KanbanImpl.tsx` does not. Not measured in a browser.
